title: Gmail read-only: CLI path
description: Scripted walkthrough of the shared Cloud and Gmail OAuth setup, then the CLI path and optional WSL repair. Playback does not install software, sign in, or read a mailbox.

commands:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install ca-certificates curl gnupg
curl -fsSL https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg |
sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg
printf '%s\n' 'deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/cloud.google.gpg] https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt cloud-sdk main' |
sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-cloud-sdk.list
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install google-cloud-cli
gcloud --version

read -r -p 'Choose a globally unique Cloud project ID: ' PROJECT_ID
gcloud projects create "$PROJECT_ID" --name='CS357 Gmail Read Test'

read -r -p 'Test Cloud project ID: ' PROJECT_ID
gcloud services list --enabled --project="$PROJECT_ID" --filter='config.name=gmail.googleapis.com' --format='value(config.name)'

(
set -eu
test "$(uname -m)" = x86_64
prefix=$(npm prefix -g)
case "$prefix" in "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"/versions/node/*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
pkg="$(npm root -g)/@googleworkspace/cli"
test "$(node -p 'require(process.argv[1]).version' "$pkg/package.json")" = 0.22.5
test "$(command -v gws)" = "$prefix/bin/gws"
test -f "$pkg/bin/gws" && test ! -L "$pkg/bin/gws"
work=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$work"
asset=google-workspace-cli-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
base=https://github.com/googleworkspace/cli/releases/download/v0.22.5
curl -fsSLO "$base/$asset"
curl -fsSLO "$base/$asset.sha256"
sha256sum --check "$asset.sha256"
tar -xzf "$asset" ./gws
./gws --version
install -m 0755 ./gws "$pkg/bin/gws"
gws --version
)
gws gmail users messages list --dry-run --params '{"userId":"me","q":"subject:\"CS357 MCP DEMO\"","maxResults":3}'

markers.title: Install the Cloud CLI on Ubuntu or WSL
markers.note: Optional for either live path. The browser console also works. Skip this block if gcloud already works. Playback does not install software.

markers.title: Sign in to the Cloud CLI
markers.note: In your own browser, sign in to manage the dedicated test project. This is separate from Gmail consent.

markers.title: Create a dedicated test project if needed
markers.note: Skip this command if you already have a test project. The Desktop OAuth client is created in that project in the browser, not by gcloud auth login.

markers.title: Check the Gmail API
markers.note: Use the ID of your own test project. If Gmail is listed, skip the next command.

markers.title: Enable Gmail only if needed
markers.note: Run this only if Gmail is absent and you have permission. In the browser, set up External testing, choose Add users under Test users and enter your test Gmail address exactly, select Gmail read-only, and create a Desktop client.

markers.title: Install the Workspace CLI
markers.note: Use Node.js 18 or later and the pinned version. No installation happens in playback.

markers.title: Diagnose a glibc error on Ubuntu 22.04 WSL
markers.note: Use this branch only if the GNU binary reports GLIBC_2.39 missing after reinstall. The replacement shown is for x86_64 with npm under nvm.

markers.title: Verify and replace only the npm package binary
markers.note: The checksum must pass before extraction and replacement. Do not change system glibc. Playback does not modify an executable.

markers.title: Store the Desktop client locally
markers.note: Use your own download and the separate private config directory. No JSON or credentials are shown.

markers.title: Authorize Gmail read-only
markers.note: Complete consent yourself with your test account. Stop if Google asks for other access. No login occurs in playback.

markers.title: Inspect the request without calling Gmail
markers.note: This is a credential-free preview, not an authentication test. In your own terminal, omit --dry-run for one read against your test inbox.

markers.title: Try the agent
markers.note: Use OpenCode or Oh My Pi and inspect the actual tool trace.
